summary_en: 50,000 shares (2.42% of shares outstanding) to be acquired at ¥60M upper limit via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-19 at previous close of ¥1,060/share. Controlling shareholder (CEO Araki Yoshitaka) to sell 25,000 of 50,000 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: AHC Group announced a block buyback of up to 50,000 shares (2.42% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-19 at an upper limit of ¥60.0M. The transaction will execute at the prior-day close of ¥1,060/share. The controlling shareholder, CEO Araki Yoshitaka, will sell 25,000 of the 50,000 shares via this same mechanism, triggering minority-shareholder safeguard procedures under the Company Governance Code. The board (excluding Araki) approved the acquisition following review by independent outside directors and auditors, who confirmed the transaction aims to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns, uses a fair-pricing mechanism (ToSTNeT-3 applies the prior close), and includes conflict-avoidance measures. Following completion of this block trade, the company intends to continue buybacks via on-market purchases through a trading mandate contract up to the same ¥60M and 50,000-share upper limits, net of amounts acquired in the block trade, over the period 2026-08-20 to 2026-11-30.
